one_liner: Designed and built a generative-UI portfolio that uses RAG and structured agents to surface the right case studies on demand.
projectSummary: Designed and built a generative-UI portfolio that combines deterministic React layouts with a RAG-powered AI layer for answering questions, navigating content, and composing recruiter-friendly views of my work.

problem.summary: Traditional portfolios bury important information behind navigation and static layouts. Recruiters have limited time and often struggle to quickly understand a candidate’s skills, experience, and impact. I wanted a portfolio that could surface the right details on demand and stay grounded in real project data.

goals: Create a portfolio that clearly communicates my skills as a design-minded applied AI engineer
Blend deterministic UI components with AI-generated content in a trustworthy way
Use RAG and structured knowledge to keep answers grounded in real case studies
Design an AI interaction model that respects user control and feels natural to use
responsibilities: Defined the overall system architecture for a generative-UI portfolio (KB, RAG, agents, renderer)
Designed and implemented front-end components in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind
Created a structured knowledge base for case studies, roles, tools, and proof points
Authored and iterated on prompts for copywriter and orchestrator agents to produce deterministic YAML and JSON
Implemented a renderer that maps a whitelisted component registry to validated layout JSON
Collaborated with AI tooling (Anthropic models, LangChain, LangSmith) to trace, debug, and refine agent behavior
outcomes: Shipped a portfolio that can answer natural-language questions about my work while staying grounded in curated case studies
Established a reusable architecture for deterministic generative UI that can be extended with features like a command palette and richer AI navigation
Created a concrete example of applied AI engineering work that demonstrates both system design and front-end implementation skills
Built a foundation for future experiments in conversational navigation, AI-assisted storytelling, and dynamic case study presentations
